sources.entry: Bazarr | Subtitle manager companion for Sonarr and Radarr

summary.one_liner: Bazarr is a companion application for Sonarr and Radarr that automatically finds and downloads subtitles for the TV series and movies those tools index.
summary.what_it_does: Bazarr takes per-series and per-movie subtitle language preferences and manages downloads to match them. It pulls the list of series and movies from Sonarr and Radarr and does not scan the disk to find media itself. It can scan an existing library for internal and external subtitles and download any missing ones. It keeps a history of what was downloaded, from where, and when, and can upgrade earlier subtitles when a better one appears. Manual search is available for on-demand downloads, and external subtitle files can be deleted from disk. The README lists a large set of subtitle providers and says it supports 184 languages, including forced and foreign subtitles depending on the provider.
use_cases: automatically download subtitles for a TV show library
fetch missing subtitles for existing movies
set subtitle languages per series or movie
upgrade low-quality subtitles when better ones appear
manually search for subtitles on demand
notable: Pulls series and movies from Sonarr and Radarr rather than scanning disk itself
Supports a long list of subtitle providers, including Whisper-based and self-hosted options
Per-series and per-movie language profiles with forced and foreign subtitle support
Upgrades previously downloaded subtitles when better matches are found
caveats: Some providers need extra setup, such as session cookies, API keys, or a self-hosted helper service
OpenSubtitles.org is limited to VIP users
Depends on Sonarr and Radarr being present to manage series and movies
keywords: manage subtitles for series and movies
